records.english: These photos show the new face of the countryside.

records.simp: 这个老街保留了当年的风貌。
records.english: This old street has kept its original look.

records.simp: 这本书写得又风趣又有道理。
records.english: This book is both humorous and thoughtful.

records.simp: 他说话很风趣，大家都爱听。
records.english: He talks in a witty way, and everyone loves listening to him.

records.simp: 我们的数学老师是个风趣的人。
records.english: Our math teacher is a funny person.

records.simp: 她风趣地回答了记者的问题。
records.english: She answered the reporter's questions with good humor.

records.simp: 这次比赛展现了年轻人的风采。
records.english: This competition showed off the talents of young people.

records.simp: 多年不见，他风采依旧。
records.english: I haven't seen him for years, but he's as dashing as ever.

records.simp: 她站在台上，风采动人。
records.english: Standing on the stage, she looked captivating.

records.simp: 不管风雨多大，他每天都去上班。
records.english: No matter how hard the wind and rain, he goes to work every day.

records.simp: 不管有多少风风雨雨，我都陪着你。
records.english: No matter what storms come, I'll be with you.

records.simp: 经过这么多风风雨雨，公司还在。
records.english: After so many trials, the company is still going.

records.simp: 人生总会有风风雨雨。
records.english: Life always has its ups and downs.

records.simp: 他们一起经历了几十年的风风雨雨。
records.english: They have been through decades of ups and downs together.
